title: Aphelion Shop Lab prototype plan
content:
Aphelion is paused at a good architectural moment: the curation surface, selected-download flow, highlights review page, and preferred-admin controls are now separated enough that a shop can be planned without bolting commerce directly onto the image wall.

Where the plan is going:

  • Prototype first: the next shop step should be an owner-only Shop Lab inside Aphelion, not a public storefront or checkout flow yet.
  • Curated groups before products: the first data model should let preferred admin create named merchandise groups from selected Aphelion image records, with fields such as title, notes, product target, status, and selected image IDs.
  • Start with shirts: shirts are the first intended product target, while keeping the model flexible enough for postcard packs and other selective merchandise later.
  • No POD commitment yet: Printful, Gelato, and Printify remain the likely comparison set, but the provider decision should wait until the product grouping and sample set are real.
  • Fixed designs first: the first shop version should use owner-approved fixed designs/mockups rather than customer crop or placement tools.
  • Auth has a future role: store/order history, product activity, and admin notifications should eventually connect into Auth through a Store/Orders-style dashboard tab.

The immediate next step is human curation: choose roughly 20 sample images. Once that sample set exists, Aphelion can grow a private Shop Lab around real examples instead of guessing too early about checkout, fulfillment, or provider APIs.
